Each has different standards. - **Budget:** Authentic 18th-century pieces can be expensive; tasteful adaptations (e.g., modern furniture with colonial-inspired details) might be more practical. - **Personal Connection:** If James has a passion for history, the choice could be deeply meaningful—even if not "objectively" correct. - **Cultural Sensitivity:** Colonial styles often carry historical weight (e.g., tied to American independence or British rule).
